name: InvestiGator
description: Explainable financial alerts for retail investors. Two processes: the dashboard (web) and the always-on alert watcher (worker).

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Bot token from @BotFather. Without it the watcher runs but never sends.

TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.description: Target channel id, e.g. @InvestiGatorMEIA or a numeric id.

FINNHUB_API_KEY.description: Free Finnhub key. Drives company news and the intraday quote.

TIINGO_API_KEY.description: Optional. Second link in the price fallback chain.

POLYGON_API_KEY.description: Optional. Third link in the price fallback chain.

ALPHAVANTAGE_API_KEY.description: Optional. Last link in the price fallback chain (25 calls/day).

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Optional. Primary provider for the grounded narrator (off by default).

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Fallback provider for the grounded narrator.

INVESTIGATOR_HISTORY_GIT.description: Set to 1 so the watcher pushes the shared alert history back to the data branch.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Only needed if INVESTIGATOR_HISTORY_GIT=1. A fine-grained PAT with contents:write on this repo.
